map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Crawford, Franklin, Henry and Trumbull publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga and Ottawa report totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares.
